source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: D230469 initially proposed combining focus selectors and dropping the explicit open-state outline override. The author reported an unwanted system-color outline during keyboard opening; the reviewer accepted that reason and requested the toolkit-style comment. The landing and fixed accepted stylesheet keep the override and comment. Preserve this narrow reason when changing the Account Hub selector. The historical control was XUL; current styling also covers HTML select.menulist, so current platform behavior still needs a live check. This is not a general instruction to suppress keyboard focus outlines.
title: Keep the reason for the Account Hub open-menu outline override
